purpose: Teach: 逐次/紀元前/派兵/軽蔑/露呈/否決/法務大臣/会計検査院

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: 蓮さん、医療チームで症例を逐次記録しております
lines.en: Ren, our medical team keeps detailed records of every case we see.
lines.style: Clear, professional opening. Steady gaze. No rush. The tone of someone who has explained this many times and will explain it again without impatience.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、紀元前の薬草研究を医療チームで参照しております
lines.en: Yes, we also reference ancient medicinal research in our team discussions.
lines.style: Consistent, slightly warmer. A light nod at the end of the sentence. Still professional but acknowledging the slightly unusual nature of the question.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 海外派兵時の医療体制を、貴院、研究されてるそうですね、先生
lines.en: I understand your hospital has been researching medical protocols for overseas deployment, Doctor?
lines.style: Respectful uncertainty — genuine question, not challenge. Slight lean forward. Careful with the honorific. The tone of a student who's done his homework and wants to learn more.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、患者さんへの軽蔑的態度は医療チームで厳禁としております
lines.en: Yes, and our team has strict protocols against any contemptuous treatment of patients — that's non-negotiable.
lines.style: Firmer now. Direct eye contact. No apology in the voice, but no harshness either. The weight of something important being stated plainly.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 医療体制の不備が露呈した事例を、貴院、検証されたんですね、先生
lines.en: So your hospital examined the cases where those system failures became visible?
lines.style: Thoughtful pause before speaking. Slower pace. He's connecting dots out loud, not accusing. The careful tone of someone working through a complex problem alongside someone he respects.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、医療予算の否決対応も医療チームで備えております
lines.en: Yes. Our team is also prepared to handle budget rejections and the responses they require.
lines.style: Steady delivery. No elaboration. A slight drop in volume on the final clause — she's saying it matters but won't emphasise it.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 法務大臣との会合を貴院、なさったそうですね、先生
lines.en: Did your hospital meet with the Minister of Justice about this?
lines.style: Careful framing as a question, though he knows the answer. Respectful distance in his tone. The politeness of someone asking about something delicate.

lines.speaker: saito_doctor
lines.jp: はい、会計検査院との対応も医療チームで行います
lines.en: Yes. We also coordinate directly with the Audit Board on these matters.
lines.style: Final statement, slightly lower energy than before. A soft close — this is the endpoint of what she's saying. Professional closure without curtness.
